user_prompt:
An infinite geometric series has the first term 3 and the third term 1/3. All the terms of the series are positive. What is the sum of the series?

A. 27/8
B. 10/3
C. 9/4
D. 9/2

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer

llm_thinking: With first term 3 and third term 1/3, I get r² = 1/9, so r = 1/3. The sum is 3/(1-1/3) = 9/2, matching answer D.
